text.p: Coastal Physician Group Inc. said Monday that it has hired Smith Barney Inc. to advise or assist it in evaluating the possible sale of the physician management company.
The decision came after the company, struggling for some time under heavy debt, disclosed last month that it would study ways to maximize shareholder value, including sale of the company.
Coastal provides a broad range of health care and administrative services to physicians, hospitals, employers, managed-care programmes and other health care providers.

In the past month alone, a member of its board of directors resigned, and net losses soared to $24.9 million, or $1.04 in the second quarter compared with a loss of $10.5 million, or 44 cents, in the same year-ago period.
The company became mired in debt after an aggressive acquisition programme that began in July 1993, faltered.
